faq.question: What is CiptadraSoft?
faq.answer: CiptadraSoft is an enterprise technology and software solution provider based in Indonesia. We specialize in digital transformation, business process automation (BPA), omnichannel customer service platforms, CRM, enterprise data analytics, and domain-grounded Generative AI solutions for corporations.

faq.question: What products does CiptadraSoft offer?
faq.answer: CiptadraSoft offers a modular product portfolio including: Ciptadra CRM Suite, Ciptadra Omnichannel Service Desk, Ciptadra Flow BPM, Ciptadra Insight BI, Ciptadra AI Virtual Assistant, and Ciptadra Enterprise Integration Gateway.

faq.question: Can CiptadraSoft solutions be deployed on-premise for strict compliance?
faq.answer: Yes. While our solutions are cloud-ready, all CiptadraSoft platforms can be deployed fully on-premise or within your private corporate virtual cloud (VPC) to meet strict data residency and regulatory mandates (e.g., OJK and Bank Indonesia regulations).

faq.question: How does CiptadraSoft help automate customer service?
faq.answer: Through the Ciptadra Omnichannel Service Desk and Ciptadra AI Virtual Assistant, we unify channels like WhatsApp, web chat, and email into one workspace. Routine inquiries (tier-1) are automatically handled by conversational AI, while complex tickets are routed with full context to human agents, reducing resolution time and agent workload.

faq.question: Does CiptadraSoft support integration with legacy systems like SAP or Oracle?
faq.answer: Yes. Our Ciptadra Enterprise Integration Gateway is engineered specifically to bridge modern applications with legacy ERPs, AS/400 systems, core banking engines, and relational databases using standard REST APIs, SOAP, and message queues.

faq.question: How can an enterprise get started with CiptadraSoft?
faq.answer: You can request a consultation or customized product demonstration by clicking 'Talk to Us' on our website, submitting the inquiry form in this chat, or emailing sales@ciptadrasoft.com. Our solution architects will conduct an initial discovery session to map your business requirements.
